d: The Accounting Lead is responsible for managing the end-to-end accounting and financial reporting function, ensuring timely and accurate monthly and annual closing, compliance with IFRS and applicable regulatory requirements, maintenance of strong financial controls, and effective supervision of the accounting team. The role will also support the Finance Manager in budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, audit, taxation, working capital management and continuous improvement of finance processes and ERP systems.
q: Excellent strategic planning skills and able to interact with all levels
Good MS Office skills specifically strong knowledge of MS Excel
Able to work independently and highly meticulous
Understand and follow oral and written instructions.
Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with those contacted in the course of work.
Minimum 3-5 years of relevant accounting and financial reporting experience, including at least 1–2 years in a supervisory role.

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance or Commerce. Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA), preferably ICAI, or equivalent internationally recognized professional accounting qualification such as ACCA/CPA.
r: Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing process, including review of journal entries, accruals, provisions and account reconciliations.
Prepare and review monthly financial statements including P&L, balance sheet and cash flow.
Ensure accounting treatment is in accordance with IFRS and company accounting policies.
Review balance-sheet schedules and ensure long-outstanding/open items are investigated and cleared.
Perform monthly P&L and balance-sheet variance analysis against budget, forecast and prior year.
Maintain and strengthen internal financial controls, including appropriate maker-checker and segregation-of-duties controls.
Ensure correct accounting and documentation for revenue, inventory, fixed assets, leases, accruals, provisions, intercompany transactions and foreign-currency transactions.
Coordinate with external auditors and internal auditors, including preparation of audit schedules and timely closure of audit observations.
Support compliance with applicable tax and regulatory requirements, where relevant.
Monitor accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory and working capital, including ageing and overdue balances.
Monitor supplier payments and ensure payments are supported by appropriate approvals and documentation.
Review bank reconciliations and ensure reconciling items are resolved promptly.
Monitor showroom/retail collections, cash deposits, card settlements and other receivables.
Review inventory accounting, inventory reconciliations, stock adjustments, provisions and stock ageing.
Ensure correct landed costing, including freight, customs and other directly attributable costs.
Review showroom revenue reconciliation between POS/ERP, payment gateways, cash, cards and bank settlements.
Monitor inventory movements and investigate accounting differences between physical and system stock.
Review provisions for slow-moving and obsolete inventory, where applicable.
Manage, coach and supervise accountants responsible for AP, AR, GL, bank reconciliation and related accounting functions.
Review work performed by the accounting team and ensure proper supporting documentation.
Establish and monitor the monthly closing calendar and ensure deadlines are achieved.
Develop team capability and ensure appropriate cross-training and backup responsibilities.
Ensure proper segregation of duties within the Finance function.

d: The Category Manager Assistant supports the Category Manager in executing strategies for product selection, pricing, promotions, and inventory management within the grocery e-commerce dark store operations. This role requires keen market awareness, data analysis skills, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally to optimize category performance and ensure product availability aligns with customer demand.
q: Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
1–3 years of experience in category management, merchandising, or retail operations, preferably in the grocery or e-commerce industry.
Familiarity with supplier coordination and inventory management.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint) and data analysis tools.
Experience with e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems is a plus.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Drive partner experience and ad revenue scale-up, optimize vendor operations in coordination with logistics, and execute topline campaigns with marketing. Ensure high-quality data integrity within Salesforce and maintain regular, strategic engagement with key partners.
Develop the strategic business plan to achieve sales objectives providing updates on periodic basis.
Maintain accurate records of sales, generate client acquisition plan and prospecting activities to analyze the sales prospects.
Develop and deploy quarterly and annual sales objectives, strategies, target plans, programs, policies and performance metrics for Country Sales teams.
Monitor performance of team in terms of restaurant partner acquisition, closed restaurants, promotions, campaigns, account management, and market research.

q: Fluency in Arabic is mandatory for this role.
